nodes.name: Shinko Electric Industries Co., Ltd.
nodes.description: Japan-based IC substrate manufacturer and OSAT competitor. Secondary player in advanced substrates behind Ibiden; strong in both ABF and BT substrates for AI accelerators and memory packages. Operating fabs in Ishikawa and other regions; expanding capacity to serve spillover demand from TSMC/Samsung.

metrics.name: Global IC substrate market share
metrics.description: Shinko Electric holds approximately 15% global IC substrate revenue share (2025), per TrendForce market analysis. Top-3 supplier after Ibiden and Unimicron.

metrics.name: ABF substrate supply share
metrics.description: Estimated 20% of high-end ABF substrate capacity for AI accelerators (2025-2026), based on DigiTimes supply-chain reporting of 2021-2023 shortage episodes.

nodes.notes: Secondary supplier in 2021-2023 ABF shortage episodes; named in DigiTimes reports as constrained maker alongside Ibiden, AT&S, Samsung. Investor relevance: growth tied to AI accelerator volume ramps and memory package demand.

nodes.name: AT&S (Austria Technologie & Systemtechnik)
nodes.description: Austria-based high-density interconnect (HDI) PCB and IC substrate manufacturer. Key player in advanced packaging substrates and high-layer-count boards for AI accelerators and data center infrastructure. Facilities in Austria, China, India; expanding capacity for 2.5D/3D packaging demand.

metrics.name: Global IC substrate market share
metrics.description: AT&S holds approximately 12% global IC substrate revenue share (2025), per TrendForce analysis. Strong in HDI and advanced multilayer substrates.

metrics.name: ABF substrate supply capacity
metrics.description: Estimated 18% of high-end ABF substrate supply for AI accelerators (2025-2026), based on 2021-2023 shortage episode analysis and recent capacity disclosures.

nodes.notes: Named in 2021-2023 ABF shortage episodes (DigiTimes, Nikkei Asia) as constrained supplier. Strong in high-density interconnect; key supplier to European and global OSATs. Investor relevance: Europe-based alternative to Taiwan/Japan supply concentration.

edges.claim: Shinko Electric manufactures organic substrate base structures for AI accelerator packages, with secondary position (~20% share) in high-end ABF substrates.
AT&S manufactures high-density interconnect (HDI) organic substrates for advanced AI accelerator packaging, with ~18% estimated share of premium ABF substrate supply.
Shinko Electric is among the suppliers of finished ABF substrate assemblies for advanced packaging, though Ajinomoto holds ABF material supply dominance.
Shinko Electric manufactures chiplet-interconnect substrates for advanced packaging with secondary player share.
AT&S manufactures high-density interconnect chiplet-substrate for advanced packaging, with strength in HDI and multilayer design.

evidence.title: AT&S High-Density Interconnect Capacity Expansion for AI Packaging
evidence.excerpt: AT&S expanding high-density interconnect capacity at Austria and China facilities to serve AI accelerator packaging demand, with estimated 18% of premium ABF substrate supply in 2025-2026.
evidence.summary: DigiTimes reporting on AT&S capacity expansion and role in high-end substrate supply for AI compute.

evidence.title: ABF Substrate Shortage Episodes 2021-2023: Supply Constraint Analysis
evidence.excerpt: 2021-2023 ABF substrate shortage episodes constrained advanced packaging capacity at TSMC, Samsung, ASE. Named constrained makers: Ibiden, Shinko Electric, AT&S, Samsung Electro-Mechanics. Shortage resolved through capacity expansion and alternative sourcing strategies.
evidence.summary: DigiTimes historical reporting on ABF substrate shortage episode (2021-2023) documenting which suppliers were constrained and how the shortage impacted AI accelerator module production.
